doc: Autotile rules for the overworld ground layer. SOURCE OF TRUTH: tools/build.py resolve() only executes what is written here (port approved by Gary, Oct 23 2026, 12:10 AM CT). Each rule-placed map also carries its semantic terrain grid as the top-level key 'terrain' in maps/<name>.json (codes below); the engine reads only layers.*, the bridge keeps unknown top-level keys verbatim.

not_ported.mirefen_bog: biome owner (maps_new/, merged by extra_merge.py, pre-built ground)

priority_note: extra_merge.register adds flood=2.5, deep=4 at run time (biome kit terrains, used by route1_storm)

neighbours.bit: 1 = neighbour terrain has LOWER priority (the edge faces it); off-map = same terrain

edge_tile.name: {T}>{A}_{sides}_{diags}[_w{w}]
edge_tile.recipe: gen_tiles.transition(base T, base A, sides, diags, 'soft' | 'water'), palette-snapped by reg()

junction.when: the lower neighbours hold 2+ terrains of DIFFERENT priority (e.g. water touching path and grass at a bridge)
junction.name: {T}>{U}+{A}_{sides}_{diags}_{usides}_{udiags}[_w{w}]
junction.recipe: under = transition(base U, base A, usides, udiags, 'soft') where u-bits mark neighbours below U; tile = transition(T, under, sides, diags) (hand-made WD recipe, no tilegen)
junction.skip_note: snow/flood/deep edges are drawn by the biome kit recipe (extra_merge); those cells keep the majority rule

rules: else side_e / side_w / side_ew / top by floor within x+-1, rows y..y+2

corners.name: cavewall_face_{l|u}_{e|w|ew}
corners.when: a face_l/face_u cell whose E and/or W neighbour on the same row is floor (the wall run ends there)
corners.recipe: gen_tiles.cliff('l'|'r', row, cave=True) end cap over the cave floor base (same art as the cliff ends)

strips.rule: decoration strip pieces pick l/m/r from their row neighbours of the same family: l = no same-family W, r = no same-family E, m = both; a lone piece is left as placed; a neighbour whose decoration starts with a 'joins' prefix (e.g. a cave mouth set into the cliff) counts as a continuation

ids.rule: existing ids never move; new tiles are numbered after the last ledger id at the end of the run
